name: Kyou, Suteinu o Hirotta.
source:
One day I found an abandoned... dog? Left in a cardboard box.
I opened it up and found the inumimi girl inside.
And a letter that said, "Love and raise this dear girl.
If you do, your wishes will come true..."

What the hell.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ179857.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
有一天我发现了一只被遗弃的……狗？留在纸板箱里。
我打开它，发现了里面的inumimi女孩。
还有一封信，上面写着：“爱并抚养这个亲爱的女孩。
如果你这么做了，你的愿望就会实现……”

到底是什么啊。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ179857.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英语[/url]]
